summary: A user described being contacted on Discord by someone claiming to be a US based crypto analyst who shared trading profits and gradually built rapport while discussing high daily earnings. The interaction shows characteristics of a pig butchering style romance investment scam designed to build trust before soliciting funds.
user_mistake: Engaged in ongoing private conversation with an unsolicited online contact promoting crypto profits
prevention: Disengage from online contacts who introduce high crypto earnings early in conversation / Avoid discussing investments with strangers met through social platforms
